incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-76821 fired for service=redwood-inference-prod-embeddings | symptom=5xx spike | region=eu-west-1

pagerduty: Pager P-76821 created by alerting-policy/high-5xx-rate. Escalation policy: inference-prod-escalation.

maria: ack

maria: taking ownership — I'm the oncall. starting triage.

kevin: thanks — ping if you need DB or autoscaler context.

maria: quick snapshot: 5xx rate ~4x baseline, latency for successful requests normal. KV cache miss rate spiked.

alice: router logs show repeated `KVCacheLookupError: timeout` across pods, repro ~40% on embeddings route.

maria: following runbook steps. first check for recent deploys or config changes.

maria: no deploys in last 30m. checking config maps and autoscaler.

sam: I pushed a cache TTL change earlier: cache_ttl=300 -> cache_ttl=30 at 10:12 UTC (config-cm). Could explain aggressive eviction.

maria: good catch. reverting config to 300s. rolling update command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap config-cm --type merge -p '{"data":{"cache_ttl":"300"}}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-router\```

kevin: rollout started, ETA ~2m for new pods to join.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty P-76821 acknowledged by maria

alice: rollback rolling, 2/3 pods restarted, new pods passing readiness.

maria: error rate dropping to ~8% now, still above baseline but trending down as cache warms. continuing to monitor.

maria: customer impact: embeddings requests returned 5xx for ~10-15m window; top-affected customers: cust-A (high QPS), cust-C. CS notified.

ops_lead: thanks. if >5% after 15m, prepare plan to failover those customers to dedicated pool.

maria: noted. warming KV cache, will update in 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: update: baseline restored — 5xx ~0.5%, warmup complete, no further 5xx for last 3m. marking resolved.

incident-bot: PagerDuty P-76821 resolved by maria (ack -> resolved)
